title: Make scenario that turns a short brief into a Klaviyo draft campaign with AI copy, sized banners and a sign-off step

facts: Post: LA direct-to-consumer fine jewelry brand (custom engagement rings and bridal) on Shopify and Klaviyo; wants brief (offer, product, theme, date) to ready-to-review Klaviyo campaign.

Post asks for AI copy with A/B variations, on-brand banners sized for email and mobile, Shopify product pull, Klaviyo build via API (template, blocks, images, links, UTM, segment, schedule), optional SMS and social, human approval before sending.

Tools open: Klaviyo API, Shopify API, OpenAI/Claude, AI image tools incl. Bannerbear/Placid, Make.com/Zapier/n8n. This rebuild uses Make (Lorenzo works daily in Make). Oct 22 deck used n8n; this one is fresh content.
No verified first name: one review says Yaniv, only one, so U-006 fallback 'your team'.
Rebuild on 2026-10-26 per Lorenzo 3:11 PM CT via COO: all saved jobs current on today's legacy template.

scenes.title: One brief runs through the Make scenario.
scenes.caption: Products come from Shopify, copy and banners are generated, and the campaign is built as a draft in Klaviyo.
scenes.beat: Your team fills in a four-line brief for anniversary week. Make pulls the emerald-cut band and two related rings from Shopify, writes the copy in your brand voice, checks it against your word list, renders the banners from your template, and builds the campaign in Klaviyo as a draft. Then it asks your marketing lead to review it in Slack.
details: If the copy uses a word on your banned list, the second route logs it for a rewrite and nothing is built
Each Make a request module stands for an API call; keys and field mapping are set up with your accounts during the build
